Subject: Next steps: deployment tradeoffs & GPU sizing for SageCart

Alex — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and skinny list of next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary workload: real-time product recommender + conversational support (hybrid synchronous flows).
- Peak TPS target: ~120 TPS for short prompts (avg 50 tokens), spiky traffic with 3x peak windows.
- Token mix: ~70% short (≤64), 30% medium (200–400) during session contexts.
- Data residency: US-only; may need VPC for compliance later.

Initial deployment options we discussed
- Hosted API: fastest to ship, simple cost model, but currently unclear on sustained SLA for 120 TPS with low 95th latency.
- Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput, preferred if you want reserved GPUs and tighter latency SLOs.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): likely for later regulated flows, adds procurement lead time.

What we need from you to finalize a dedicated-sizing estimate
1) Confirm 95p latency target for recommender (target <=200ms token generation) — is that right?
2) Share an example token distribution for a 1-minute sample (attachment would be perfect).
3) Do you expect batching-friendly traffic (many concurrent short requests) or long-lived streaming sessions?

Proposed next steps
- Alex: please send the token profile CSV and confirm the 95p latency SLO by EOD Friday.
- Lauren (cc): will coordinate procurement introduction if SageCart wants dedicated.
- Karthik (cc): can we schedule a 30-min sizing call next week to walk through model variants and GPU tradeoffs?

Attachments: suggested token-profile template (SageCart_MVP_token_profile.csv)

Thanks,

Mina / Lauren — reviewed the sample CSV and Alex’s targets. High-level sizing notes and questions below (will capture on the call if we confirm):

Quick read / proposal (conservative)
- Suggested GPU family: A100x (dense FP16/AMP) for predictable latency on short prompts; consider H100 if customer wants headroom for larger models later.
- Baseline slots: assume 1 slot = sustained ~30 TPS with 50-token avg when using our continuous batching. For 120 TPS sustained with 3x burst protection, plan for 6 baseline slots + 12 burst-capable slots (total 18 slots) mapped across 3 GPUs (6 slots per GPU) — this gives headroom for spikes and KV cache benefits.
- Expected 95p token generation latency: ~160–200ms on A100x with optimized kernels for short tokens (matches their <=220ms target).
- Cost/throughput trade: H100 would reduce slot count by ~30% for medium token-heavy requests but increases committed cost. Recommend A100x baseline with optional H100 burst nodes if SageCart wants lower unit cost on medium-length sessions.

Questions for Alex (to confirm on call)
- Are you planning to use a larger LLM for agent-assist vs. the recommender? If so, list model family and expected average sequence length.
- For the 300 concurrent bursts, do those map to independent short requests (batch-friendly) or many open streaming sessions?

Deliverables I’ll prepare before Monday call
- 2-page dedicated estimate (PDF) with baseline vs. burst SKUs and rough monthly committed cost (will attach as Redwood-dedicated-estimate-v1.pdf).
- Short slide showing latency/slot assumptions and how slot->GPU maps.

I can take Monday 11/9 10am PT. If that works, Mina please go ahead and book.

—Karthik
